newsitem.title: POLAND: NOMURA SEES CORRECTION HITTING POLISH BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: NOMURA SEES CORRECTION HITTING POLISH BOURSE.

text.p: The Warsaw bourse, buoyed early this year by an inflow of foreign funds, should soon hit a correction phase after more possible short-term rises, Nomura Equity Research said in its February East European report.
"Although further gains seem likely in the short term, the market should go through a correction period sooner or later," the report dated January 31 said.
Nomura also said Polish firms would likely take advantage of current market conditions and announce plans for further capital increases.

The report said construction stocks were gaining sharply in anticipation of stronger growth for the industry this year, a point confirmed by Nomura company visits uncovering growing orderbooks and gradually expanding margins.

It said last year's financial problems of Espebepe had led to a flight to quality in the construction sector which should help the major companies raise their prices without losing business to smaller, more aggressive bidders.
Nomura said bank WBK and aluminium plant Kety were its tops picks.
